e/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generate

al-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this aft
er a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into

ns/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n- [Delete a
n eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past runs t
